tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha chen mkhan gsar skos skabs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tho bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lnga bdo'i 'gro ba 'dren phyir gos dkar ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zol 'chang ba/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam bzhis bstan 'gro skyong mdzad rje btsun dbang po'i grangs ldan sogs/ /'jam mgon gong ma rim par byon pa'i skyes chen mtshungs bral 'gro ba'i mgon rnams rgyal gyur cig /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i tshig sngon du btang nas skabs don bstan bya'i gtso bo ni/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i lha khang chen mo zhes phyogs kun tu grags pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde chen po'i slob dpon nam mkhan po'am/ rje bo lta bur gyur pa mang thos bshes gnyen 'dzin pa rnams bsko bzhag gi skabs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol zhig gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la yod kyang tho sogs la gsal cha ma thebs pa'i dbang gi rjes 'jug rnams blo rmongs par gyur gyi dogs nas 'dir thor bkod pa la/ thog mar nged rang dpon slob ban gtsang pa bcas na bza' gzab bzhes ngos/ gung gral gyi mjug tu tshogs phyag lan gsum mdzad/ de rjes shis brjod kyi spyan 'dren pa'i slad du sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum la/ tshig rkang gsum pa'i bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i dge ba zhes par/ chos spyod bgyis ba'i dge ba zhes par bsgyur/ de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'khor nyan thos mchog brgyad kyis bskor ba la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar gyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de nas/ ji snyed su dag nas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'i bar mdzad rjes/ ye dharmā tshar gsum/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhes sh+lau ka gcig

de nas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ khyad par du yang rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'khor nyan thos mchog brgyad la sogs pa gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdor na dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad dus 'dir bdag cag dpon slob rnams la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mi nyams shing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dge 'dun gyi sde 'di'i mkhan por mang thos 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'di nyid mnga' gsol ba la/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs thams cad kyis bkra shis pa dang byin brlabs kyi dpal 'bar bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas dpon slob tshang mas zhwa gyon zhing lag tu me tog thogs nas/ thog mar phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis/ de mdo mang nas 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi bkra shis/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par gzigs ni zhes pa nas/ shākya thub pa'i bar mdzad/ de nas mtshungs med bla ma/ bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang gnyis pa/ 'jig rten 'dren pa༞bdag gis tshe rabs༞ rnam rgyal༞ 'jig rten༞ nye sras brgyad༞ gnas bcu sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang༞ zab cing rgya cher༞ nor gyi dbang phyug༞ sku bsod ri bo༞ ston pa 'jig rten༞ mi 'gyur lhun po༞ bgegs rigs stong phrag༞ 'gro ba'i bla ma༞ nged rang gis bgyis pa'i yab rje'i gsol 'debs mjug gi rgyal ba'i sprul pa༞ gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad dkar nyid/ /mi zol dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan pa/ /kun dga' snying zhes mtshan mchog ldan pa des/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /de nas nyin mo bde legs ma gdangs ma brjod/ de nas re zhig gyes/ slar mkhan por phyag 'bul sogs skabs thob dang bstun nas mdzad/

ces pa 'di yang rang lta bu'i gang zag rnams la phan pa'i phyir sa skya pa kun blos lha chen phun tshogs gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lha chen mkhan gsar bskos skabs phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
